notes.title: Wishlist My New Game: WordScoop!
notes.content: [h2]Introducing: [i]WordScoop! With Gelato the Otter[/i][/h2][previewyoutube="fxTCEa_lGEI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Hey, folks![/b][/p][p][/p][p]As of late, I've been finishing up a new game: [i]WordScoop! With Gelato the Otter.[/i] The gameplay revolves around finding words hidden within a matrix of ice cream scoops, while trying to prevent creatures called VOIDs from reaching the bottom. [/p][p][/p][p][i]WordScoop[/i] was actually developed as my senior thesis project in college! For the assignment, I wanted to challenge myself by making a sort of game I've never done before. [/p][p][/p][p]If you've seen the trailer, you may have noticed that the game hearkens back to some of the downloadable computer games of the early 'oughts, albeit with its own spin! [/p][p][/p][p]I would be honored if you put the game on your wishlist. I'm between jobs and planning to someday do GameDev full time, so your support means the world to me![/p][p][/p][p][b]Link to Steam Page:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3797690/WordScoop_With_Gelato_the_Otter/?curator_clanid=4777282"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
